{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS255 |prevtitle=With a Spoink in Your Step I |nextcode=PS257 |nexttitle=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XV |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=With a Spoink in Your Step II |subtitle=Final Training |title_ja=VS バネブー II |title_ro=VS Baneboo II |image=PS256.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 256 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|21}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 256 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|21}} |location={{gdis|Mirage Island|III}} }} '''With a Spoink in Your Step II''' (Japanese: '''VS バネブー II''' ''VS {{tt|Baneboo|Spoink}} II''), titled '''VS Spoink II''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 256th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 76th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Final Training''' (Japanese: '''最後の大特訓''' ''The Final Training'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Final Training''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}, {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} continue their training with the [[Gym Leader]]s, [[Tate and Liza|Tate, Liza]], and [[Juan]]. On Mirage Island, time moves differently than the outside, and because of it, when Ruby and Sapphire slept for three days on the island, 21 days passed outside. However, although time works differently on Mirage Island, it is never always the same. Although when Ruby and Sapphire first arrived on the island, one day meant seven days outside, it has now changed to the opposite effect. Only when the passage of time of both Mirage Island and the outside are the same is when people can move freely about the two areas. While Ruby and Sapphire were shocked to learn about this, another surprise awaits the two Trainers. Ruby and Sapphire continue training with Tate and Liza. With the teamwork of {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}}, they manage to defeat Tate and Liza's two {{p|Spoink}}. Although defeated, Tate and Liza praise the excellent strategy that Ruby and Sapphire used. Sapphire, happy to be praised by Gym Leaders, thanks Plusle and Minun for their help and for meeting each other again. Tate and Liza state that in order to beat {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}, they will need to master [[Double Battle]]s. Assuming that Ruby and Sapphire are exhausted, Tate and Liza leave to take a break. Sapphire looks around to see Ruby coming up with battle strategies for Pokémon other than Plusle and Minun. Sapphire quickly remembers what is happening in the outside world and decides that there is no time to rest. Elsewhere, Juan asks Tate and Liza about the results of their training. The twins state that their students are showing promise, and the training has caused their Pokémon to become much stronger. As they point this out, [[Rono]] [[Evolution|evolves]] into his final form, {{p|Aggron}}. Juan is pleased to hear this, but states that he is not surprised as the two were recommended by [[Wallace]]. He states that it is Ruby and Sapphire's destiny to fight Groudon and Kyogre. Although pleased at Ruby and Sapphire's progress, the point where time moves faster outside is soon approaching. Back at Ruby and Sapphire's location, Sapphire has [[Chic]] master {{m|Sky Uppercut}} to help in their Double Battle training. Juan approaches the two and states that it is time for their next lesson. He takes them to a spring and has them both look into it along with their Pokémon. Juan puts a coin in his hand and has Ruby and Sapphire guess which hand the coin is in. Ruby gets only a few correct, while Sapphire gets all correct, signifying that she has a better intuition than Ruby. Juan reveals that in heated battles, there are times where one has to come up with a plan on the spot, but this can be hindered by swaying emotions. Juan states that the next challenge will involve training their hearts. Sapphire begins falling asleep due to the effects of the spring, so Juan decides to hold off on training until later. Later, while Sapphire sleeps, Ruby decides to talk to Juan alone. Ruby reveals that he knows that Juan is hiding something from his students, which angers Ruby. Ruby takes off his glove, which has the pattern on Groudon's body on it. Ruby states that Juan has been hiding the fact that the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s have been absorbed into Ruby and Sapphire's bodies. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} obtains a {{TP|Ruby|Plusle}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} obtains a {{TP|Sapphire|Minun}}. * Ruby and Sapphire continue their training with [[Tate and Liza]]. * Sapphire's {{p|Lairon}}, [[Rono]], evolves into an {{p|Aggron}}. * Ruby reveals that he and Sapphire have the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s inside them. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Aggron}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * [[Tate and Liza]] * [[Juan]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Delcatty}} ([[Kiki]]/{{tt|Coco|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Swampert}} ([[Mumu]]/{{tt|Zuzu|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo]]/{{tt|Popo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Plusle}} ({{OP|Ruby|Plusle}}; new) * {{p|Lairon}} ([[Rono]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s; evolves) * {{p|Aggron}} ([[Rono]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s; newly evolved) * {{p|Blaziken}} ([[Chic]]/{{tt|Toro|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Tropius}} ([[Troppy]]/{{tt|Pilo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Donphan}} (Phado/{{tt|Dono|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Minun}} ({{OP|Sapphire|Minun}}; new) * {{p|Spoink}} ([[Tate and Liza]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Luvdisc}} ([[Juan]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Wynaut}} (multiple) * {{p|Regirock}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants|Adventures]]; flashback) * {{p|Regice}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants|Adventures]]; flashback) * {{p|Registeel}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants|Adventures]]; flashback) ==Trivia== * This chapter's [[VIZ Media]] name comes from the phrase ''A spring in your step''. ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, [[Juan]] states that {{adv|Ruby}} was wrong when he guessed that the coin was in his left hand.
